source: National Information Infrastructure Protection Act of 1996, Pub. L. 104-294, §201, 110 Stat. 3488
wound_addressed: 1984 Act's narrow scope left commercial internet computers unprotected; no civil remedy for victims
design: Expanded 'protected computer' to any computer affecting interstate commerce (universal); added §1030(g) civil cause of action with $5,000 loss threshold
